title: Lake Matheson/Te Ara Kairaumati Walk: Westland Tai Poutini National Park, West Coast region
overview: Walk through lush rainforest to Lake Matheson. It’s world-famous for its mirror reflections of New Zealand’s highest mountains.
No dogs. Other pets on conservation land rules.
lines: Department of Conservation Te Papa Atawhai
Department of Conservation | Te Papa Atawhai

From Jetty Lookout, walk for 15 min through forest to View of Views Lookout at the top end of the lake. A signposted side track with steps leads to the lookout. Take a seat and enjoy magnificent mountain views framed by native trees.
It's another 5 min from Jetty Lookout to Reflection Island. Steps lead down to a viewing platform over the lake. On a fine day, there are clear views of the Southern Alps/Kā Tiritiri o te Moana.
From Reflection Island, it's 35 min to the car park via the wetland at the eastern end of the lake.
Lake Matheson car park is a short drive from Fox Glacier/Weheka. Follow Cook Flat Road for 5 km, then take the signposted road on your right to Lake Matheson.
This is a popular walk. It gets busy during the summer season (November to April).
Bookings are not required for Lake Matheson/Te Ara Kairaumati Walk.
The nearest DOC campsites are Gillespies Beach Campsite (30 min by car) and Otto/MacDonalds Campsite (45 min by car).
Enjoy the reflective views of the glacier valley and mountains on this short, easy walk to a small kettle lake - it's a great option with children.
